subject: Critical: CloudWave throughput spike RCA, exec commitments & action tracker
messages:
From: Jenna Lopez <jenna@cloudwave.io>
To: nikhil_sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudWave SRE <sre@cloudwave.io>
Date: 2027-02-25T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Realtime inference errors impacting checkout

Hey Nikhil —

We started seeing a sustained spike in 5xx errors and long tail latency on calls to /v1/generate around 02/25 07:30 PST. This is directly impacting checkout on a subset of our customers (approx 12% traffic routing through Redwood). Attached is a small slice of request logs and a screenshot of the 502 page.

Key observations from our side:
- Errors ramped quickly from 0.2% -> 8% over ~10 minutes.
- Elevated p95/p99 latency (p99 > 3s).
- Retries by the frontend amplifying traffic into the service.

We need: immediate mitigation, a clear RCA, timeline for fixes, and guidance on credits/SLA. Please loop in SRE and your execs if needed.

Thanks,
Jenna Lopez
Head of Product Operations, CloudWave
attachments: request_log_20270225.csv, screenshot_error_502.png

From: nikhil_sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Lopez <jenna@cloudwave.io>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>, CloudWave SRE <sre@cloudwave.io>
Date: 2027-02-25T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Realtime inference errors impacting checkout

Jenna — thanks for the heads up and the logs. I’m escalating to our SRE and runtime lead. Preliminary plan:
- Immediate mitigation: route CloudWave traffic to the smaller model variant and enable aggressive prefix caching to reduce backend token work (15–30 min).
- Short-term: rollback yesterday's model rollout that coincided with the spike if the mitigation confirms improvement.
- Long-term: RCA and permanent fixes (24–72 hours).

Marcus — can you own the immediate mitigation and confirm a safe rollback path? Laura — I’m looping you given potential customer credits and exec comms.

I’ll post updates in this thread every hour until stabilized.

— Nikhil
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: nikhil_sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, CloudWave SRE <sre@cloudwave.io>
Date: 2027-02-26T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Realtime inference errors impacting checkout — initial findings

Team — quick tech summary from the runtime side after the first mitigation run:

What we saw:
- Around 07:30 PST there was a model rollout that changed KV cache key formatting for decode paths. That triggered a cache miss storm across active replicas (cache TTL still valid but keys not matching), causing a sudden increase in GPU work per request.
- Amplified by frontend retries and lack of backpressure, this pushed some shards over capacity, producing 502/503s and rising latencies.

Immediate actions taken (yesterday):
1) Rolled CloudWave traffic to the smaller model variant (sv-sm-1) and re-enabled the previous KV key format — net improvement in p95 within 12 minutes.
2) Throttled burst window for CloudWave at the routing layer to limit retry amplification.

Proposed corrective actions:
- Patch: add a compatibility layer for KV key formatting to prevent rollout-induced cache invalidation (owner: infra/runtime, ETA 48h).
- Safeguard: add rollout gating that runs a KV-compatibility check before global model switches (owner: deploy tooling, ETA 72h).
- Observability: add a dedicated KV-miss alert with a 5-min burn threshold (owner: telemetry, ETA 24h).

I’ve attached the filtered request slice and a short flamegraph extract. Marcus
attachments: request_log_20270225.csv

Folks —

Short version: CloudWave experienced a KV cache compatibility issue during a model rollout that caused a spike in backend work and downstream retries. Marcus’s mitigation reduced the error rate quickly, but CloudWave is asking for a formal RCA, timeline for fixes, and consideration for SLA credits.

Proposed asks for exec alignment (please reply with owner + ETA by EOD):
1) Customer comms package (email + public postmortem summary): owner: nikhil_sharma, ETA: 2027-02-28 12:00 PST
2) SLA credit recommendation (legal + finance input needed): owner: laura_bennett, ETA: 2027-02-28 17:00 PST
3) Technical fix ship (KV compatibility patch): owner: marcus_lin, ETA: 2027-02-28 18:00 PST (aiming sooner)
4) Console & billing adjustments (apply interim credit in billing system): owner: grace_oconnor, ETA: 2027-03-01 10:00 PST
5) Post-incident follow-up review with CloudWave leadership (schedule): owner: karthik_iyer, ETA: 2027-03-02

Please confirm you can commit or reassign. We should keep public comms concise and empathetic, include clear remediation steps and timelines.

— Laura
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Subject: CloudWave RCA and corrective actions (draft)

Jenna — attaching the draft RCA (cloudwave_rca_draft_v1.pdf) and the short action tracker below. Appreciate feedback from your team on acceptance and whether you want a joint exec readout.

Executive summary:
- Root cause: incompatible KV cache key format produced during a model rollout, causing a cache miss storm and overloaded replicas.
- Impact: increased p95/p99 latency and a peak 8% 5xx rate for ~22 minutes; estimated 12% of CloudWave checkout traffic affected.
- Mitigation: immediate rollback to previous KV key format and temporary routing to smaller model variant; throttling at edge to reduce retry amplification.

Action tracker (owner / ETA / status):

- SLA credit recommendation / laura_bennett / 2027-02-28T17:00:00-08:00 / in progress

- Billing interim credit / grace_oconnor / 2027-03-01T10:00:00-08:00 / queued

Nikhil
